clauses.reason: The first scope is the order's recitals and section 1, signed 1961-01-24 (26 FR 781). The recitals are not operative commands. Section 1 amends Executive Order 10900 (administration of the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954) by renumbering its sections 6 and 7 as sections 7 and 8 and inserting a new section 6, under which the Director of the Food-for-Peace Program, subject to the direction of the President, "shall be responsible for" the continuous supervision and coordination of the functions delegated or assigned by that order to officers or agencies of the Government. The renumbering was executed on issue; the inserted section continued as part of EO 10900. Later event 1: Executive Order 11252, signed 1965-10-20 (30 FR 13507), section 1: all functions of the Director of the Food-For-Peace Program, including those under EO 10900 as amended, "are hereby transferred to the Secretary of State; and that order" "and memorandum are modified accordingly." Section 4: "This order shall take effect on November 1,1965." Before: the coordinating responsibility in section 6 rested with the Director of the Food-for-Peace Program; after: the Director's functions rested with the Secretary of State. EO 11252 does not name EO 10915 or section 6 and prints no replacement text. Later event 2: Executive Order 11963, signed 1977-01-19 (42 FR 4325), section 2: EO 10900 is further amended by revoking section 5 and "redesignating Sections 6, 7 and 8 as Sections 5, 6 and" 7 respectively. On that date section 6 was the Food-for-Peace section inserted by this order (no held amendment renumbered EO 10900's sections between 1961 and 1977), so the inserted section was renumbered section 5 with its text unchanged. Before: section 6; after: section 5. EO 11963 has no effective-date wording, so its signing date is recorded; the publication date 1977-01-24 is the alternative reading. The redesignation shows the section was still part of EO 10900 in 1977, so the 1965 transfer is not treated as an end. First end: Executive Order 12220, Agricultural Trade Development, signed 1980-06-27 (45 FR 44245, Federal Register of July 1, 1980), section 1-501: "Executive Order N o. 10900 o f January 5,1961, as am ended, is revoked." EO 12220 has no effective-date wording (the held text was searched), so the signing date 1980-06-27 is recorded; the publication date 1980-07-01 is the alternative reading. The cited source is the held Federal Register text of EO 12220; the dossier's located-provision record for this pair is an American Presidency Project transcription and is not cited. The inserted section (section 5 since 1977) ended with that revocation.

Section 2 of Executive Order 10915 is the command to amend Executive Order 10893 (administration of mutual security and related functions) by "adding at the end of Part I thereof a" new section 111. First end: Executive Order 10973, signed 1961-11-03 (26 FR 10469), section 605 ("Superseded orders.") lists as item (b) "Section 2 of Executive Order No." 10915 of January 24, 1961 (26 F.R. 781), and as item (a) EO 10893 except Part II and except for the purposes of using funds under section 643(c) of the Act. Section 607 provides that the provisions of the order "shall become effective" "as of September 30, 1961." The end date recorded is that stated effective date, 1961-09-30, which is retroactive; the signing date 1961-11-03 and the filing date 1961-11-06 are the alternative readings. The cited source is the held Federal Register text of EO 10973; the dossier's located-provision records for this pair are American Presidency Project transcriptions and are not cited.

The text of new section 111 of Executive Order 10893, inserted by section 2 of EO 10915, makes the Director of the Food-for-Peace Program, subject to the direction of the President, responsible for the continuous supervision and coordination of the functions under section 402 of the Act (22 U.S.C. 1922), without superseding any delegation made by the Act or by other sections of that order. It has the same end as section 2: Executive Order 10973 supersedes section 2 of EO 10915 by name (section 605, item (b)) and supersedes EO 10893 except Part II and one funding purpose (item (a)); section 111 was added at the end of Part I and concerns coordination of section 402 functions, so neither exception keeps it. Recorded end: 1961-09-30, the effective date stated in section 607 of EO 10973 ("as of September 30, 1961."), with the signing date 1961-11-03 as the alternative reading.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 10915 (26 FR 781, Federal Register of January 26, 1961), signed by John F. Kennedy and dated January 24, 1961; number, date and subject agree with the census register. Inventory: I confirm the dossier's three scopes: (1) the recitals and section 1, which amends EO 10900 by renumbering its sections 6 and 7 as 7 and 8 and inserting a new section 6 (Director of the Food-for-Peace Program); (2) section 2, the command amending EO 10893 by adding a new section 111 at the end of its Part I; (3) the text of section 111 itself. Ends: section 2 and section 111 end on 1961-09-30, when EO 10973 section 605(b) supersedes section 2 of EO 10915 by name and section 605(a) supersedes EO 10893 except Part II and one funding purpose (section 607 makes EO 10973 effective as of September 30, 1961). The inserted section 6 of EO 10900 ends on 1980-06-27, when EO 12220 section 1-501 revokes EO 10900 as amended. Later events on the inserted section 6: EO 11252 (effective 1965-11-01) transfers all functions of the Director of the Food-for-Peace Program, including those under EO 10900 as amended, to the Secretary of State and modifies that order accordingly; EO 11963 section 2 (1977-01-19) revokes section 5 of EO 10900 and redesignates sections 6, 7 and 8 as sections 5, 6 and 7, so the inserted Food-for-Peace section became section 5. The whole-order end is the latest clause end, 1980-06-27. The dossier's missing items were resolved by reading the held texts: EO 10924 section 4 says it does not supersede or derogate from EO 10893; EO 11963 was read in full, and EO 12148 and EO 12220 were searched for every provision naming EO 10900. Searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes (all three complete, no coverage warning): the U.S. Code release point 119-121 and eCFR searches record no citation of this order; the Federal Register catalog notes (four machine hits) record the partial supersession by EO 10973 and notes naming EO 11963 and EO 12148 as amending.

savings.reason: Section 606 of EO 10973 ("Saving provisions.") continues determinations, orders and other actions taken with respect to any function affected by that order, and not revoked or made inapplicable before its date, until amended, modified or terminated by appropriate authority. Actions taken under section 111 are therefore accrued effects; they do not keep section 111 operative. The functions of the Director under section 6 of EO 10900 were transferred to the Secretary of State by EO 11252; EO 12220 has no savings clause of its own.
